summary_en: This Phase 2 study is testing whether adding histotripsy, a focused ultrasound treatment, to durvalumab works in people with advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. Durvalumab is given by IV infusion on day 1 of each 28-day cycle, and histotripsy is performed on Cycle 1 Day 8, with participants followed until progression for up to 5 years. The study measures whether adding histotripsy increases immune response and the safety of the combination.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa si agregar histotricia, un tratamiento con ultrasonido enfocado, a durvalumab funciona en personas con colangiocarcinoma intrahepático avanzado. El durvalumab se administra por infusión intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y la histotricia se realiza el día 8 del ciclo 1; los participantes son seguidos hasta la progresión por hasta 5 años. El estudio mide si agregar histotricia aumenta la respuesta inmunitaria y la seguridad de la combinación.
who_for: Diagnosed with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma confirmed by a prior biopsy.
Disease controlled after 18 weeks of gemcitabine and/or cisplatin plus durvalumab.
Tumor suitable for liver biopsy and histotripsy; solitary tumor at least 2.0 cm.
Tumor unresectable or not a surgical candidate.
Child-Pugh score A or B (up to B8) and ECOG performance status 0-2.
not_for: Target tumor previously treated with ablation, embolization, or radiation.
History of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Untreated central nervous system metastasis, or live vaccine within 28 days of durvalumab.
